title: Dollars to đồng / billboard
slide_intent: Turn a transfer into a simple visual relationship because an audience should grasp the action before reading details.
strategic_value: Two currency words joined by a colorful control can make Wise’s international transfer offer concrete.
demonstration: A roadside billboard pairs Dollars and Đồng across a green field, with a pill-shaped colorful connector and small Wise signature.
practical_value: Assess how few elements are needed to explain movement between currencies at distance.

content_islands.name: Currency relationship
content_islands.spec: Place the two large currency words on either side of the central connector.

content_islands.name: Signature and setting
content_islands.spec: Keep the small logo above and retain supports and sky for viewing scale.
